items.title: PNC Bank Introduces New Personal Loan Experience with Fast Access to Funds, Predictable Monthly Payments
items.why: Incumbent banks are upgrading digital loan UX, so our card-linked installment features need to match that speed.
items.summary_ai: PNC has rolled out a revamped personal loan experience promising faster access to funds and fixed monthly payments.
items.take: Incumbent banks are upgrading digital loan UX, so our card-linked installment features need to match that speed.

items.title: PNC Bank, National Association (PNC) Launches Personal Loans in 49 States
items.why: A wider national footprint for PNC loans adds competition for the same affluent borrowers we target.
items.summary_ai: PNC is now offering personal loans across 49 states.
items.take: A wider national footprint for PNC loans adds competition for the same affluent borrowers we target.
